Aditya / Lauren — reviewed Aditya's attachments and ran two scenarios against current policy:

Scenario A — 3% waiver for 12 months
- First-year ARR (net) drops ~3.0% (~$18k reduction in recognized ARR in year one)
- Cashflow impact: negative ~$18k on first-year cash but maintains list price and avoids future price pressure

Scenario B — $50k one-time credit applied at signing
- Equivalent to ~8.3% of the first-year net value, but is bookable as a discount/credit (cleaner for marketplace reconciliation)
- Larger near-term revenue hit but easier to account for in the marketplace private-offer flow

Policy note: our standard marketplace playbook allows credits and partner-managed promotions but waivers of brokerage fees are rare and generally need Deal Desk + Finance sign-off (commercial exceptions >$10k). Given the numbers, either approach is defensible.

Recommend: propose a hybrid — waive 3% for 6 months and include a smaller $25k signing credit to bridge procurement. That reduces our hit versus a full-year waiver and gives the buyer runway. If you want to preserve net ARR, we can also cap the waiver to first $400k of spend.

I'll prepare a short internal justification memo for Deal Desk. Please confirm which variant you want me to model into the private_offer_draft.pdf.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Susan / Josh — thanks for the patience. After discussion with RevOps and Finance we can offer the following commercial concession to get Acme across the line this quarter: 

Proposal (private offer variant):
- Waive the 3% marketplace brokerage fee for the first 6 months, capped at the first $400k of billed spend.
- Provide a $25,000 one-time signing credit applied at invoice 1.
- Term: 12 months, with standard renewal pricing thereafter.

Rationale: this hybrid reduces Redwood's up-front revenue impact while materially improving Acme's procurement economics. It also limits marketplace reconciliation complexity for Azure. 

If this is acceptable to Acme, we'll:
1) Publish a private offer on Azure Marketplace with the above terms (marketplace-ops included here to expedite publication).
2) Send DocuSign for signature (link below).
3) Apply the credit on the first invoice and mark the marketplace fee exception in our deal record for audit.

DocuSign (private offer): https://app.docusign.com/transactions/details/0A1B2C
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/789312
